messages:
incidentbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired (PD-8472) — SEV2 — inference-eu embedder pool high 5xx rate. Affected: eu-west-1, impact: elevated latency and errors for embeddings and generation routes. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/embed-5xx

pagerbot: pd-ack auto-claim attempted -> alex claimed (primary oncall). Escalation window in 5m if no ack.

alex: acked — I'm on it. starting with logs + pod list. will check kvcache and qps.

priya: joining — running log-collector, grabbing traces from 2 recent requests.

alex: quick evidence: spikes correlate with a rollout to dedicated-embedder:v12 around 12:22 UTC. seeing repeated 500s with stack: `kv_cache.ReadTimeout` in logs.

priya: snippet from log-collector:
```
2026-03-17T12:26:58Z embedder-12 error GET /v1/embeddings 500 kv_cache.go:142 timeout waiting for shard lock
2026-03-17T12:27:03Z embedder-12 warn request id=abc123 latency=1024ms
```

mart a: @alex @priya fyi I'm pausing the v12 rollout in eu-west-1 (k8s rollout pause). will confirm pod versions. :white_check_mark: 

alex: thanks marta. priya — can you tail the autoscaler events? want to see if pool scaled down unexpectedly.

priya: autoscaler shows rapid pod churn between 12:21–12:24, several pods OOMKilled then restarted. hints of memory regression in v12.

alex: ok, mitigation plan: 1) pause rollout (done), 2) revert embedder to v11 in eu-west-1, 3) drain and recycle failing pods, 4) monitor error rate. I'll start revert.

oncall-ops: noted escalation; customer-facing comm (if needed) in 30m. any ETA for mitig?

marta: performing revert to v11 now: `kubectl set image deploy/embedder embedder=redwood/embedder:v11 -n eu-west-1`

priya: metrics: 5xx rate starting to drop at 12:30 UTC from 8% -> 2% (prelim). latency 95p also trending down.

tim: running a quick smoke test against generation & embeddings endpoints — embedding requests at 12:31 succeeded (200).

alex: drain/restart completed. rolling back removed the OOM pattern. continuing to observe for 10m.

oncall-ops: customer impact summary in short: Partial degradation for embeddings and generation for EU region only. Impacted: some PLG customers and a subset of premium customers during 12:22–12:31 UTC. No data loss.

priya: timeline note: root cause appears to be memory increase in v12 leading to pod churn and kvcache timeouts. follow-up: regression test and memory profiling before re-rolling v12.

marta: filing follow-up ticket: INF-2789 (v12 memory regression + kvcache resilience). assigning to runtime team.

alex: status update: errors returned to baseline, routing healthy. I'll keep monitoring for another 20m then close.

incidentbot: PD-8472 status -> acknowledged -> resolved (mitigated) pending postmortem.

priya: short customer note draft: "We briefly experienced elevated errors and latency for embeddings and generation in eu-west-1 due to a faulty embedder rollout. We reverted the rollout and services have recovered. We're investigating and will follow up with a detailed postmortem."

oncall-ops: good. mark keep-warm for customers hit and flag for SRE postmortem. closing ack in 20.

alex: closing note: mitigation successful, no further errors in last 5m, handing to tim for monitoring handoff.

tim: monitoring for 30m, will alert if any regression. thanks team. :heart:
